batch_lessons: ADS demonstrates that EPS growth can coexist with severe multiple compression; understanding why a stock is cheap matters more than observing that it is cheap.
When several business units have simultaneous temporary problems, test for a common governance, portfolio or capital-allocation cause.
Conglomerate simplification does not guarantee rerating if the remaining business deserves a lower financial-company multiple.
Autodesk shows that deliberate subscription transitions can make reported accounting worse while improving lifetime economics; ARR, subscription counts and retention are better transitional KPIs.
Autodesk 2018 also shows that the core mechanism can be correct even when a precise FCF forecast misses: the $240 price target was achieved despite FY23 FCF of about $2.03b versus $2.4b targeted.
ADT's three ideas show the increasing quality of evidence from accounting critique to financial engineering to direct CAC/attrition business mechanics.
Leverage and buybacks amplify both improving and deteriorating recurring-revenue unit economics.
